overall: The AG found that a committee member's October 30 email with an opinion document to a quorum of the three-member committee was an unlawful deliberation; the committee was ordered to comply and to publicly disclose the email.

allegations.summary: A committee member emailed a quorum of the committee an opinion document about school and town issues, asking recipients not to reply, outside any posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Mr. Barton's email to a quorum of the Committee distributed a document that expressed his opinions on matters of public business within the jurisdiction of the Committee.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a future similar violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation.
Publicly disclose the October 30 email and attached document at the committee's next meeting, if not already done.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that a future similar violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the Law.
